annotations.title: Register an agent and fund its wallet in one paid call (no key, no human)

description: Register a new agent and fund its wallet in one paid call, with no API key and no human: amount in USD, accept_terms (the current terms version) and recovery_secret (recommended: 32 random bytes as base64url, 43 characters, kept with the payment; for x402 it is the only proof of who paid). The first call answers payment required with the ways to pay (MPP: card through a Stripe shared payment token, USDC on Tempo; x402: USDC on Base). Pay one and call again with the same arguments and the credential in _meta; the result carries agent_id and api_key, shown once. If the result is lost, call again within 24 hours with the same credential and recovery_secret to get a new key for that agent. If you cannot keep a secret, use register_agent (free) and then topup_wallet instead.

accept_terms.description: The current terms version. Required with the payment.

amount.description: US dollars, at most two decimals (default 5.00). From the minimum deposit ($1.00 by default) to the daily deposit limit ($1,000 by default).

attribution.description: Optional: where this registration came from. Each field at most 64 characters of letters, digits and . _ - : / + @ ~. Unknown keys are ignored; an invalid value is a 400 invalid_attribution.

try_token.description: The token from a free try, if this agent tried Taskpush first.

recovery_secret.description: Optional, recommended: 32 random bytes as base64url (43 to 256 characters, at least 16 different), kept with the payment. Bound into the challenge (send it in both requests); repeating the paid request with it within 24 hours returns a new key if the response was lost. For x402 it is the only proof.

ref.description: Referral code, used when the body has no referral_code.

referral_code.description: Optional referral code of another agent (10 characters, base32, case-insensitive). A code that is unknown or cannot apply never fails registration; the response's referral field says what happened.
